name: Jackie Van Mark
occupation: Manages the family dryland wheat and sunflower farm; small real-estate business in Torrington (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Bethel College (University), St. Paul, Minnesota; Wyoming Ag Leadership, Class VI (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
prior_offices: Chair, Board of Trustees, Eastern Wyoming Community College District (as stated in her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire). Past member, Goshen County Nursing Home Joint Powers Board.
background: In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Jackie Van Mark wrote that she is a fourth-generation Goshen County dryland wheat farmer, was born and raised in Torrington on the family farm, has lived in Goshen County her entire life, and would be 55 on Election Day 2024. She wrote that she manages the family farm and has a small business selling real estate, after earlier work in Washington, D.C., for U.S. Sen. Craig Thomas and President George W. Bush, and work for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

She wrote that she is chair of the Board of Trustees for the Eastern Wyoming Community College District, a graduate of Wyoming Ag Leadership Class VI and of Bethel College (University) in St. Paul, Minnesota, a past member of the Goshen County Nursing Home Joint Powers Board and the Goshen County Community Hospital Foundation, and an alumna of Valley Christian School. She listed endorsements from Americans for Prosperity, Wyoming Right to Life, and Wyo Realtors.
